title: mine evidence to extend IN_STATES for US
headline: IN_STATES needs no extension for US because IN_STATES is structurally unreachable from US rows: STATE_MAPS is country-keyed (normalize.py:250) and normalize_address reads smap = STATE_MAPS.get(country, {}) (normalize.py:318). Mining did surface a NEW latent defect: US_STATES and IN_STATES share 7 keys meaning different states (ar ga la mn or tn ut), carrying 976,874 US address-token occurrences = 81.47 per 1000 US address rows. Inert today only because lookup is country-scoped and because an accidental len>3 guard in learn_translit.py:55 filters all 7 out.
primary_answer: Nothing should be added to IN_STATES for US. Zero possible effect on any US row, by construction rather than by measurement.

gaps: Multi-word keys are unmeasurable: build_profile.py:126-127 splits on [,;] then tokenises with [a-z0-9]+, so 'andhra pradesh' is stored only as tokens 'andhra' and 'pradesh'. The 30 zero-evidence multi-word IN_STATES keys are UNMEASURED, not absent.
Their constituent words do appear in India (pradesh 783159, uttar 443572, bengal 331662, tamil 366913, nagu 366795) which is circumstantial LIKELY support only.
No component-position field: cannot tell whether a state token sits in the state position or elsewhere in the address. All rates are raw token frequencies and may overstate state function.
No bigram/co-occurrence field: F6 pairs rest on independent unigram counts, not same-address co-occurrence. All pairs are LIKELY at best.
No per-row entity linkage: F2 exposure is a token-count exposure, not a demonstrated scoring error.
Cannot assess whether US 'or' rows and India 'orissa' rows could ever be cross-matched by the model.

LEET is not applied to addresses at all (normalize.py:342-349). 519,989 mixed alpha-digit address-token occurrences across 145 distinct tokens, dominated by ordinals (2nd 19721, 4th 19461, 3rd 19019, 5th 16825, 1st 16478). The ordinal gap is already covered by D075 (396,959 uncanonicalised) and is NOT re-derived here. Whether any of those 145 would be wrongly leeted if LEET were extended to addresses is unmeasured.

refuted_findings_addressed: Neither REFUTED-1 (France pin guard) nor REFUTED-2 (FR_REGIONS too thin) is supported by my evidence. My task is US/IN_STATES-scoped and I did not re-derive either.
